component.name: Caster Soundboard
component.summary: Touch-first soundboard and live audio routing tool for Linux

description.p: Caster Soundboard is a high-performance, touch-first soundboard and live audio routing application designed for podcasters, streamers, and live broadcasters on Linux (Wayland and X11).

ul.li: Responsive touch-first soundboard tile grid with bank switching across multiple tabs
Seamless virtual audio routing with zero configuration via PipeWire and PulseAudio
Push-to-Talk (PTT) automation with custom hotkeys, ducking, and microphone mute integration
Interactive audio waveform visualizer with trim handles, looping, and cue point auditioning
Local Web Remote control surface accessible from smartphones, tablets, and secondary monitors
Multi-track audio ducking with configurable attenuation and smooth release timing
Open Sound Control (OSC) and Model Context Protocol (MCP) AI remote integration
Hardware output device selection and per-stream remapping

screenshot.caption: Main soundboard view with responsive tile grid and audio waveforms
Orthogonal audio routing diagram with PipeWire virtual sinks and source remapping
Sound tile drawer with interactive cue points and waveform editor

description.p: Enabled virtual audio routing in Flatpak sandboxes, resolved blank dropdown items in the audio device selector, fixed boundary alignment on audio cards and shortcut dialogs, and increased default window width to prevent top bar buttons from clipping.

Fixed PipeWire default source name collision on shared node names (#27), normalized XKB scan code offsets in PTT/Mute key capture (#28), prioritized key capture over active hotkeys (#28), and enhanced contrast of advanced audio settings checkboxes.
Batch import directories directly into soundboards, clone tabs, manage PTT profiles with custom names, and customize all top action bar global shortcuts.
Complete QML touch-first redesign with PipeWire/PulseAudio virtual routing, dual-monitor web remote, Push-to-Talk automation, interactive cue points, and multi-track ducking.
Added audio output device selection dropdown with dynamic routing and persistent device preferences.
